name: xcodebuild-tools
description: Work with Xcode projects from inside Visual Studio Code

xcodebuild-tools.showLogChannelBeforeAct.description: An array of commands, before starting of which, their corresponding output is shown. Possible commands are: "loadProject", "clean", "build", "buildAndDebug", "debug", "buildAndProfile", "profile", "buildAndRun", "run", "attach"

xcodebuild-tools.clearLogChannelBeforeCo.description: An array of commands, before starting of which, their corresponding output is cleared. Possible commands are: "loadProject", "clean", "build", "buildAndDebug", "debug", "buildAndProfile", "profile", "buildAndRun", "run", "attach"

xcodebuild-tools.statusBarItems.description: An ordered array of status bar item identifiers to setup after always first identifier "build". See setting statusBarItemPriorities where keys are possible identifiers.

xcodebuild-tools.statusBarItemPriorities.description: A mapping from status bar item identifier to a priority, by Code only documented as number, being relative to all extensions status bar items. At the time of writing this, a basic scanning of locally installed extensions (using pcre and sort) the values have a mean of about 4.5 (if removing "extremes" of -1, 0, 1, or value > 900; also a median is similar if using uniq).
xcodebuild-tools.statusBarItemPriorities.description//personal.sh: < ~/data/$'vgreps -o ~:.vscode:extensions \'createStatusBarItem\\s*\\([^()]*\\)\''.txt gawk 'match($0,"createStatusBarItem.*(Left|Right), *([-+]? *[.0-9]+)",m){print m[2]}'|sort -n|uniq|gawk '{values[iter++]=$0 ; sum+=$0 ; printf "%s", iter": "$0 ; if (0<$0&&$0<900) {saneValues[saneIter++]=$0 ; saneSum+=$0 ; print " (sane "saneIter")"}else{print ""}} END {count=length(values) ; saneCount=length(saneValues) ; print "count: "count ; print "sane count: "saneCount ; print "mean: "sum/count ; print "sane mean: "saneSum/count ; print "median: "values[int(count/2-1)]" || "values[int(.5+count/2-1)] ; print "sane median: "saneValues[int(saneCount/2-1)]" || "saneValues[int(.5+saneCount/2-1)]}' # similar with basic integer interpretation removing . in [.0-9] # cspell:ignore vgreps

xcodebuild-tools.reloadStore.description: Xcodebuild-tools retrieves project info like schemes and build configurations from `xcodebuild -list`. Running `xcodebuild -list`, even outside of Code, for unknown reasons, can be very slow. This setting specifies a file path for project info to, when non-existent write by, and when existent read instead of, retrieved project info. If the setting is unset or empty the file path is unused.

customEditors.displayName: Xcode Interface Builder Storyboard or XIB XML

scripts.build: echo -- ; date +'%F %R' ; time tsc -p ./ ; e=$? ; date +'%F %R' ; r()(return $e) ; r
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.dev-test-transpiled: npm run compile && npx mocha out/test-dev/dev.js
